author: Maxim Ivanov <ivanovmg@gmail.com>
message:
Add helper class ParticlesLocator

Previously the function ``trackpy.feature.locate``
contained a lot of procedures, which made it difficult to comprehend.

The class ``ParticlesLocator`` allows the following:
 - Validation of input parameters using property setters.
 - Readable methods, extracted from commented regions.
 - Public method ``locate``, which contains a readable sequence
 of steps to be carried out before returning the coordinates.
